title: schc: superseded schc_authority.{c,h} still in-tree; host test passes against code Zephyr no longer ships
description: Non-blocking hygiene from 2hp4 codereview (all 3 passes converged). After removing schc_authority.c from the Zephyr module (2hp4), the superseded trust-record impl schc_authority.c + include/lichen/schc_authority.h remain in-tree. Two hazards: (1) both schc_authority.h and schc_session_authority.h define 'struct lichen_schc_authority' and lichen_schc_authority_init/install/revoke but with INCOMPATIBLE layouts/signatures — any future TU that includes both headers fails to compile; (2) the standalone host test tests/schc_authority (11/11 passing) exercises code the Zephyr build no longer ships, a false-confidence hazard. Options: delete schc_authority.{c,h} + tests/schc_authority (its richer cases — record cap boundary, generation exhaustion — are largely mirrored in tests/schc_session_authority), or rename the old impl's symbols/header into a distinct namespace if it must be retained. Decide with G4 cleanup (docs/spec-coverage/03-adaptation-flagged.md:24).
